summary: Frontend UI testing BLOCKED by a critical navigation bug in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (Gate). The auth-gate effect redirects any authenticated user who is NOT on a (tabs) route back to /(tabs)/home. This makes every /module/* screen — including /module/donations, /module/expenses, /module/pending-dues — completely unreachable on the web preview. Consequently, the entire donation/expense improvement PR (qa-donation → auto-open donation-sheet, qa-expense → auto-open expense-sheet, partial payment flow, editing rows, pending-dues drill-in) CANNOT be exercised via the deployed app. Direct navigation to https://festival-hub-46.preview.emergentagent.com/module/donations (with or without ?open=new) redirects to /home. Tapping the qa-donation quick action from Home also lands back on /home. Auth setup (President via Mongo user_sessions + localStorage vs_session_token) is verified working — /api/auth/me returns 200 with the seeded President user, and Home renders correctly with stat cards showing existing data (Collected ₹9,118, Spent ₹5,950). Backend regression was covered in iteration_5 (80/80 pytest). No new backend tests were run in this iteration since the request is frontend-only.

integration_issues.flow: Any navigation to a /module/* screen (donations, expenses, pending-dues, etc.)
integration_issues.issue: Gate effect in app/_layout.tsx force-redirects authenticated users to /(tabs)/home whenever segments[0] !== '(tabs)'. Since /module/* routes have segments[0] === 'module', they always get redirected away. Consequence: qa-donation, qa-expense, pending-dues-card, and every module route in the app is unreachable. Directly opening the URL /module/donations?open=new redirects to /home before the screen mounts, so the ?open=new auto-open behaviour cannot be verified.

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx Gate. Line 24 currently reads `else if (user && !inTabs) router.replace('/(tabs)/home');` — this is wrong: it kicks the user out of every non-tabs route (including /module/*). Change the else-if to only redirect when the user is on the login screen, e.g. `else if (user && onLogin) router.replace('/(tabs)/home');` OR add `segments[0] === 'module' || segments[0] === '(tabs)' || onLogin` to the whitelist. After the fix, /module/donations, /module/expenses and /module/pending-dues become reachable and the whole PR (qa auto-open + partial + edit) can be verified end-to-end.

After the fix, re-run frontend testing to validate the 8 acceptance criteria in the review_request (qa-donation auto-open, simple donation flow, partial donation with pending dues, donation edit, qa-expense auto-open, simple expense flow, expense edit, and + header regression).
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx Gate uses `segments[0] === '(tabs)'` as the only allowed area for authenticated users. This is too restrictive — it blocks the entire /module/* subtree that the app relies on. The auth guard should whitelist all authenticated routes (or better, only redirect off /login), not restrict to a single group.

This bug is a regression from the previous iteration (iteration_5 was backend-only and could not have caught it). Recommend adding a smoke Playwright test that navigates to /module/donations after login and asserts donations-screen is visible.

rca_of_issue: RCA: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:19-25 — the Gate effect has two branches. Branch A (`!user && !onLogin` → /login) is correct. Branch B (`user && !inTabs` → /(tabs)/home) is buggy: it treats ANY route outside the (tabs) group as an authenticated user landing in the wrong place, and force-redirects them to /home. But /module/* is a valid authenticated area of the app. Reproduction: (1) seed a President user + session in Mongo; (2) set localStorage vs_session_token; (3) navigate to /module/donations — observe URL is rewritten to /home and donations-screen never renders. Mitigation: change branch B to `user && onLogin` so the post-login redirect only fires from the login screen; other authenticated routes render normally. This single-line fix unblocks the entire donation/expense feature verification.
